approval_timestamp_basis: Time the explicit user approval was recorded by the assistant.
approval_context: Explicit approval of the exact longer action observation plan: implement, validate and execute one resumable pass over the two fixed cores, importing compatible completed pilot caches and producing two complete new review videos.

source_and_scene_policy.source_pixels: Original native RGB frames, with the existing 120 PNG records reused unchanged and remaining frames extracted into new ignored paths; lossy source previews are not model inputs.
source_and_scene_policy.raw_reads: Bounded seeks/decodes covering only the two cores and necessary decoder preroll; no model inputs outside the cores, no full-game decode or full-source rehash.
source_and_scene_policy.verification: Bind existing full-source audit and unchanged size/mtime, frame maps, exact extracted PTS and source RGB hashes. Separate input manifest contains no fabricated annotations.
source_and_scene_policy.cuts_replays: Inspect source continuity before inference; explicitly segment any confirmed cut/replay boundary. No triplet crosses a declared boundary. Mark withheld frames if a segment cannot supply a complete triplet; record reduced counts rather than extending scope.
source_and_scene_policy.counts: Triplet counts are maxima assuming no internal segmentation; reductions retain explicit reasons and do not authorize replacement inputs.

cache_and_memory_policy.prior_imports: Read-only import of compatible prior triplets (116 planned) with their complete original identities, bytes and attempt receipts; record new-run provenance separately. A newly declared scene boundary can exclude an incompatible old triplet but never triggers its reinference.
cache_and_memory_policy.invalid_prior_cache: Investigate missing/mismatched/corrupt completed evidence; never silently delete, rewrite identities or reinfer completed triplets.
cache_and_memory_policy.streaming: Three-image rolling buffer and unfinished target sums, preserving ascending triplet-start float32 addition order.
cache_and_memory_policy.resume: Atomic completed caches, each actual model-call attempt retained, compatible completions reused; the 116 planned imports do not count as new calls.
cache_and_memory_policy.old_pilot_result: Preserve the original 120/120 short-context score and accepted videos. With no new scene boundary within a pilot's context, its 56 interior means should be identical and four edge means may change with longer context (112 unchanged and eight edge frames across both pilots). Report any boundary-related context difference separately.

outputs.observations: Every frame has native PTS, original source mapping, candidate list, selected point or explicit missing/withheld state, contribution count, confidence semantics and cache provenance.
outputs.summaries: Observed/missing/withheld counts and native-time intervals are availability, not accuracy. No new-label scoring or repeat of the original pilot evaluation.
outputs.review: Two complete source-plus-model videos at source PTS pacing, declared 1-second final holds, and a page with slower-playback controls. No fictitious reference points outside the accepted pilot; no invented ball trail across gaps.
outputs.assistant_review: Inspect all timeline frames and missing/switch/recovery intervals; give exact source-frame review cues. Human acceptance remains separate.
outputs.storage: Keep raw frames,caches,videos and detailed audits ignored; commit only source,tests,configuration and compact records.

validation_before_real_run: Producer-derived native input and cache import fixtures; exact old source/model/identity checks.
Streamed float32 aggregation matches existing producer semantics, including endpoints and segmented boundaries.
Changed scope/cadence rejection; no old-cache reinference; resume preserves failed attempts and consumed calls.
Actual synthetic native-PTS extraction/render transport, complete frame inventory and final hold.
Focused checks proportional to changed components; no automatic full-suite rerun.

resource_estimate.basis: Existing 120 PNG sizes, 116 NPZ sizes and observed 2.797 seconds of model-call time; extrapolations, not measured longer-run results.
resource_estimate.safeguards: Check current disk/RAM/GPU/process ownership; bounded frame loading, single owned model worker, preserve attempts. Stream review encoding to avoid thousands of retained composite images.

preserved_history: The original proposal remains an immutable proposed/pending snapshot; this later approval authorizes its exact scope. Preserve all original pilot outputs, reviews, failed attempts and consumed resources.
